# Key-lock qualification recordings

The two unmodified WAV files are from **VocalSet: A Singing Voice Dataset (1.2)**, by Julia Wilkins, Prem Seetharaman, Alison Wahl and Bryan Pardo (2018), Northwestern University. Source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.1442513.

Licensed under **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International**: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. See `VocalSet-CC-BY-4.0.txt` for the terms and disclaimer of warranties. No endorsement is implied. The project MIT license does not replace the recordings' CC BY 4.0 terms.

These are complete archive members, with no edits or normalization: singer f1 (soprano) and m1 (baritone) sing slow forte C arpeggios on vowel i. `sources.json` records exact member paths, hashes, acquisition checks, format and duration. Rendered derivatives must retain this attribution and disclose processing.

These files are test-only listening and regression material; they are not factory samples or production embedded assets. They cover two recorded singing voices and one vowel, not an exhaustive vocal corpus. No human listening scores have been supplied.
